calculate_cost: calculate the cost of AI/ML flux image generation given a model name and image response
get_model_info: get model pricing info for an AIML provider using litellm's get_model_info function
validate_image_response: validate that an image response is of type ImageResponse before calculating cost
count_generated_images: count the number of generated images from an ImageResponse data list
compute_total_cost: compute total cost by multiplying cost per image by the number of generated images
